subject: maths
question: Rohit bought an article for ₹4,400. He spent ₹3,600 on it. He marked the price 25% above his total cost price. He then allowed two successive discounts of 19% on it. Find the selling price (in ₹) of the article.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of the article = ₹4,400.

Additional expense = ₹3,600.

Marked price = 25% above total cost price.

Two successive discounts = 19% each.

**Formula Used:**

Total cost price = Cost price + Additional expense

Marked price = Total cost price + (25% of Total cost price)

Discounted price after successive discounts = Marked price × (1 - Discount1) × (1 - Discount2)<
